note: Life under a kept log or loose stone (docs/future/11 L3a, src/world/finds/under-log.js): what a Lift on foot finds, rolled from the log's seed, the game day and the ground, never saved. Each kind: where (ground: painted kinds it lives on; on: 'log' or 'stone'), when (minDays kept, seasons by index 0 spring..3 winter, spring.fromPhase: only this far through spring or later, hours of the day), chance (base, then each of damp, shade, nearWater and age adds its share, at most ground.most), count, clusterShare (how far along the log a cluster spreads, as a share of its length), scale (drawn this many times real size), shape (procedural mesh numbers, under-log-meshes.js) and legs (leg-rig.js) and scuttle (how it runs when uncovered).

ground.note: How the ground under a piece is read (under-log.js groundUnder): damp from the habitat grid's moisture; nearWater 1 within nearWaterFullM of fresh water, 0 beyond nearWaterM; shade from tall plants within shade.radiusM (weight x size, full at shade.full; the same weights as L2's log ageing); grass when its painted share is grassMin or more; soil when grass and soil together are soilMin or more; the age share rises over ageFullDays past a kind's minDays.

look.note: How they are drawn while a lifted piece is up (src/world/finds/under-log-live.js): shown while the piece is at least showFromUp of the way up; they run for cover coverShare of the piece's thickness past where they lay, away from you (under the rolled-back log); wetSpecular and contactShadow for their pass; a tap within tapM finds one.

lift.note: Lift on foot (src/world/pieces/lift.js): offered on a piece's card within reachM of you (from your feet to the log's middle line or the stone's middle, less its half thickness); the piece rolls back for holdS (in place of pieces.json tip.holdS and driftwood.roll.holdS), then settles; lifted again the same game day, it rests.
